offers_products.reason: Offers only home care, home health and hospice services; no products sold.

offers_services.reason: Personal care, skilled home health and hospice delivered by caregivers in clients' homes.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Elderly, disabled and chronically ill individuals receive in-home care and hospice, plus some private pay clients.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Contracts with state and city agencies, Medicaid programs and managed care payers fund much of the care.

recurring_revenue.reason: Personal care clients receive ongoing services under multi-year government contracts and continuing care plans.

cyclical_demand.reason: Personal care, home health and hospice for elderly and disabled clients are needs-based, largely government-funded care.

big_ticket.reason: Ongoing personal care visits, home health and hospice are routine, frequent services, not large one-off purchases.

people_delivered.reason: Caregivers and nurses' time and skill is what clients pay for; service stops if staff leave.

large_customers.reason: Largely paid by state and local government programs, Medicaid and managed care organizations, though patients receive care.

asset_heavy.reason: Home care delivered at clients' homes through branch offices; growth needs little plant or fleet investment.

notes: Payers are mostly government programs; individual patients receive the care.
